title: Egusi Soup
description: Egusi Soup is a Nigeria classic prepared with goat meat, yellow onion, crayfish, scotch bonnet pepper. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Spinach stands in for regional Nigerian soup greens; ground egusi, palm oil and crayfish retain the defining flavor base.

steps.instruction: Pat the main ingredients dry. Brown in a hot heavy pan in batches for about 12 minutes, turning to color all sides.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 50 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Mix ground egusi with a little water into a thick paste; add in small lumps to the hot palm-oil broth and let them set gently.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 20 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
